title: Ordinary uniform ranks for iterated Picard direct images
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a finite locally free module [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], $g:T\to S$, and assume $R(f,E,g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Let $F=E$ or $E^\vee$, $p=\operatorname{pr}_2:X\times_S T\to T$, $G=\operatorname{pr}_1^*F$ and $M=p_*G$, using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and ordinary pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Then $M$ is finite locally free. Moreover, every $s\in T$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and $r\in\mathbb N$ such that for every $k:Y\to U$, $p_{k\iota,*}v_{k\iota}^*G$ is finite locally free of rank $r$, where $p_{k\iota},v_{k\iota}$ are the projections of $(X\times_S T)\times_T Y$. This only compares ordinary objects and asserts no invertibility of any canonical map.

source.place: steps 1 and 2: identity tests, nonempty-fibre rank propagation, and iterated ordinary images

proof.text: Apply R to the identity of T. Use identity and composition of tensor pullbacks and the isomorphism of fibre products induced by id_T followed by g=g to identify its first two rank tests with restrictions of M. Fixed-rank local frames on these neighbourhoods give finite local freeness of M.

At s retain an identity-test neighbourhood V and rank r. Separate its empty-fibre and nonempty-fibre parts. The empty-fibre locus is clopen by properness and flat finite presentation; on that part all direct images after further base change are zero, so choose rank zero.

On the nonempty-fibre part apply R after every k:Y to V at each y. The third rank tests have ranks r and n on the same pulled-back E. A point of the fibre after a common residue-field extension makes the local ring nonzero, and comparison of the two finite free frames gives r=n. Equivalently the existing stalk-finrank comparison supplies this rank equality for the ordinary source and target. The dual frames have the same rank. This gives rank r on each test neighbourhood.

The canonical isomorphism from the iterated fibre product to X times_S Y and tensor-pullback composition identify its direct image with the further test in R. Transport the local rank-r frames and glue using locality of fixed-rank finite local freeness. Empty Y is vacuous and zero rank uses empty frames.

lean.statement:
theorem picardRankMatch_ordinary_ranks {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hR : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F = E ∨ F = Modules.dual E) :
    let G := (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F
    let M := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f g)).obj G
    M.IsFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      ∀ s : T, ∃ U : T.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ,
        ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ U.toScheme),
          SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
            ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) (k ≫ U.ι))).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) (k ≫ U.ι))).obj G))
            r
